subject: general
question: Seven people, D, E, F, G, Q, R and S, are sitting in a row facing north. No one sits to the left of F. Only four people sit between F and D. Only three people sit to the right of Q. G sits to the immediate left of S. E is not an immediate neighbour of Q. Who sits at the rightmost end of the line?
solution:
Given: Seven people, D, E, F, G, Q, R and S, are sitting in a row facing north.

1) No one sits to the left of F.

2) Only four people sit between F and D.

3) Only three people sit to the right of Q.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9d23e2a715ffbe468ebf66683bc54cea27032ea7d339b07e6ab50fcbb1078666.png] 

4) G sits to the immediate left of S.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/92efb0f802320470f2c202f5b188bc9e3b87c72538843434be3c7469125fb405.png] 

5) E is not an immediate neighbour of Q. 

After positioning E only one position is left which will be occupied by the only person left i.e. D.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4db6edd345d6b1ffd701f2382c6302522c55742d8e5304e5802eb501d4709abf.png] 

Thus, E sits at the rightmost end of the line.

Hence, "Option 4" is the correct answer.
